pairs.question: His animadversis rebus quae proxima cura?
pairs.answer: Noscere tutelas adiectaque numina signis et quae cuique deo rerum natura dicavit.
pairs.derivation: Authorial-rhetorical: the poet asks what the next topic is (quae proxima cura?) and immediately answers it himself. The answer is the operative response 'noscere tutelas... dicavit'; cut before 'cum divina dedit magnis virtutibus ora...' which begins to elaborate on why the gods were assigned, rather than naming the next concern. Stopped at the clause end (dicavit) rather than the later full stop at 'posset' because what follows is explanatory digression, not part of the direct answer.
